title: Quarterly strategic readout toolkit: stakeholder narratives, scenario testing, and escalation playbooks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a reusable, stakeholder-targeted toolkit for quarterly roadmap readouts and executive briefings. The toolkit will include: 1) one-page narratives tailored to exec/board/engineering/customer success audiences; 2) a modular slide deck with optional deep-dive appendices; 3) a scenario-testing workbook (sensitivity matrix + cutover plans for major risks); 4) an escalation & rollback playbook with named owners; and 5) a rehearsal checklist and scoring rubric. The goal is to reduce prep time for QBRs by 40%, ensure consistent messaging, and provide a clear, repeatable process for surfacing risks and mitigation options to leadership.
acceptance_criteria: Stakeholder-specific 1-pagers completed for exec, board, platform, and sales (editable in Google Drive)
Master slide deck template with clear sections: headlines, key metrics, three scenario outcomes, open risks, and asks
Scenario-testing workbook created and validated with product and eng inputs (sensitivity thresholds defined)
Escalation playbook documented with named owners and SLAs for decisions/actions
Two dry-run rehearsals completed with internal stakeholders; recording and feedback captured; >=80% checklist pass rate
